Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:

>Is it true what they say that not only are you renaming Jyhad and making

>this game for like grade schoolers and junior high kids (ie XTC laced blood,

>rules will be changed to make the game play like MtG? If any of this
>is true then let me be the first to say that most people are happy with
>the game as it is (just reword some cards and change the rulebook a little)

Those are probably the wildest rumors I've heard about the V:TES
change. The game will only be undergoing surface changes for V:TES, much
as Magic mostly underwent surface changes for Revised Edition, and then
for Fourth Edition. There will not be a widespread revision of the art,
and the rules are not undergoing a major voerhaul. They will, however, be
split up into two section: the basic rules to get people introduced to the
game, and the advanced rules which basically restores the game to Jyhad.

Tom Wylie rec.games.trading-cards.* Network Representative for
aa...@cats.ucsc.edu Wizards of the Coast, Inc.
